gates.required: Actual Seed-compatible approval of precise files/tasks; no app-code execution follows merely from finalizing these docs.
Allowlisted material classes, courses and versions plus permission to process them by the selected actor.
Approved development environment, network install and reviewed exact versions/license/provenance; no global/native app replacement.
Real intended devices/browsers available for testing; emulation alone is not real-device proof.
User reviews device/Brain key fingerprints and allowed course/actions; Drive files do not self-enroll.
Actual independent browser/companion grant and verified read/write scope; no copied native connector tokens.
Reviewed test labels, allowed provider calls, input disclosure and usage/time budget.
Actual private repository identity, required checks and permissions approved; configs alone do not activate protections.
Verified sidecars/owner locks and observed safe writer tests plus explicit canonical publication scope.
Explicit model/binary download, license, resource and privacy review; no hidden API billing.
Per-device permission and explicit Record action; no passive capture or unapproved raw retention.
Explicit disposable native target and safe effective permissions; independent process-readable terminal result under current runtime.
Authorized current schema/helper source snapshot and safe isolation review, preserving pinned owner runtime.
Reviewed local tools/model identities, hardware limits, input permission and original-preserving outputs.
Review exact tested commit/artifacts, all active coverage and critical gate evidence before tag/promote.
Chosen hosting account/origin/visibility and any cost approved; deploy only static app code, never academic data.
